subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.------WO.EXT.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 79 ((AF)D-7). VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; WO-EXT-PRI is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: SPT-GH (spiritual growth) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From SPT-GH: ACT (activism). From PROG-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: TR-INFO (trans-information). From TR-INFO: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: MOT-DY.
